items.reason: A lightweight, gentle peptide cream that suits starting a smoothing, firming routine early.
The low-strength retinal eye cream you asked for, used at night to support the look of smooth skin around the eyes.
Retinal makes skin more sun-sensitive, so a daily mineral SPF 50 should go with it.

response.routine_note: Use the peptide cream morning and night, and apply the retinal eye cream at night only, starting every second or third night and building up as your skin feels comfortable. Apply the SPF every morning as your last step.
